verdict.rationale: Embedding white-label payroll through a partner API is a fair question for a payroll/PEO provider, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers Justworks' own UI workflows and a Xero accounting sync, which is an adjacent integration, not an embeddable partner API. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or developer docs, so there is no evidence of an embedded or white-label payroll offering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API
